frozen_parameters.ci: paired percentile spatial-block bootstrap, 10 km blocks, 1999 draws, seed 20261025
frozen_parameters.surface_duplicate_stop: Spearman rho > 0.90 against any focus registry raster
frozen_parameters.dot_duplicate_stop: Spearman rho > 0.90 or candidate dot fraction within 3 px > 0.70
frozen_parameters.promotion: candidate beats both fold-safe baselines; paired delta CI lower bound > 0; >=3/4 fold wins; all canary/uniqueness/validator gates pass

score_policy: All local metric values must be labelled HOLDOUT-DTI with evaluator version, withheld-positive count, and 95% CI. No numeric projection is a score.
slot_policy: No upload is performed. Promotion to a weekly slot is a separate selector action.
